items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I don't know what they called themselves but Jim Young was the leader of the band. Bass player, he once played with Keith Smith... I played with them there for two months

ctx.x: I don't know anything about her.
She was over in England with Keith Smith band for a while. Uh-huh. That's when I first met her.
Did you say you went to Belgium too? Yeah. Did you hear any bands there?
